title: Velvety Croatian Pork Wrap
description: A kid-friendly Croatian dish featuring dark soy sauce and score-fat, wrapped in a ti-leaf for a fun and unique meal. This dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner or a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Score the pork shoulder in a crisscross pattern and season with salt and black pepper.
Wrap the pork shoulder in foil and roast for 2 hours.
Remove the pork from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Shred the pork into bite-sized pieces and mix with dark soy sauce and score-fat.
Add diced onion and minced garlic to the pork mixture and stir to combine.
Wrap the pork mixture in ti-leaves, making sure to seal the edges tightly.
Serve the wraps hot, garnished with additional soy sauce and score-fat if desired.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
